$comment: Read by scripts/check-staff-list-template.mjs. `pending`: list pages still to move onto ListPage; delete an entry when its page moves. `exempt`: pages under a list-level route that are not lists (overviews, hubs, settings, live tools, redirects). `extraListRoutes`: list pages under a dynamic segment. `rowOpenPending`: list pages on ListPage that do not yet declare what a row opens (DataTable `rowHref` for the record's page, or `useQueuePanel` for a work queue); delete an entry when its list adopts one. `rowOpenNone`: lists whose rows open no record (settings lists edited in a dialog).

exempt.reason: Component sheet: the shared elements in every state
Settings: weekly hours, rules and closures for collecting works
Settings: a switch with the short report that tells staff when to turn it on
Framing catalogue: a short fixed list of options, not a searchable work list
Settings editor: four fixed regions and a country list
